title: Friends Golden Dataset
description: Schema for the golden dataset fixture files used in evaluation

prompt_id.description: Unique slug for this test case, e.g. 'rival-chef-s01'

user_prompt.description: The sitcom episode concept prompt passed to the generation pipeline

acceptable_variations.description: Valid alternative ways to achieve the quality guidelines

entries.user_prompt: Monica discovers a rival chef is opening a restaurant next door and becomes obsessed with outdoing them, while Chandler tries to stay out of it but gets accidentally involved.

quality_guidelines.narrative_goal: Monica's competitive obsession escalates to absurdity before she finds perspective through Chandler's accidental involvement

character_arcs.Monica: Starts hyper-competitive, escalates to chaos, lands with self-awareness and warmth
character_arcs.Chandler: Tries to avoid conflict, gets dragged in, defuses with humor

quality_guidelines.comedy_approach: Escalating situational comedy driven by Monica's competitiveness; Chandler's sarcastic deflection as counterpoint
emotional_beats: Monica's brief moment of doubt (Act 2 break)
production_constraints: Maximum 2 sets: Monica's restaurant kitchen and Central Perk
quality_guidelines.thematic_focus: Competitiveness vs self-acceptance; love as grounding force

must_include: Monica cooking or in kitchen context
At least one callback to Monica's competitive history

acceptable_variations: The rival chef can be male or female
Central Perk scenes may be replaced by Monica and Chandler's apartment
Joey can appear as a supporting character providing comic relief
